verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own docs show per-release error visibility: you can see which code versions are throwing exceptions, and deploy tracking unlocks additional features. That gives glancing support for the 'new issues per release' part of the story. The Metrics API resource is only a developer building block and earns no credit, and no evidence describes actual dashboards. missing for 10: cross-project/team dashboards, top-regressions views, volume-over-time trend charts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
